_comment: Finance Intern data. SOLE SOURCE: Google Drive 'My Income & Expenses' -> 'Monthly Overview' and 'Annual Overview' tabs, January 2026 onwards. The Monthly Budget tab is NO LONGER a source and must never be read again (Joseph, 9 Aug 2026). Nothing before Jan 2026 is carried. Goals, salary and liabilities are stated facts confirmed by Joseph, not sheet reads.
source: Google Drive — 'My Income & Expenses' → Monthly Overview + Annual Overview tabs (Jan 2026 onwards)

employment.note: Joseph started work in August 2026. Jan-Jul 2026 ledger income is pre-employment and accurate as recorded. From Aug 2026 the monthly income is the $4,800 take-home PLUS anything logged in that month's Monthly Overview.

salary.note: Confirmed accurate by Joseph. CPF is 20% of gross and is not spendable cash — it accrues to the CPF balance.

projection._note: Per Joseph, 9 Aug 2026: projections run on the $4,800 take-home plus CPF. Melissa's $4,080 is NOT in the projection by default even though goal amounts are household-scale — the dashboard exposes a toggle and flags the gap rather than silently choosing.

actuals.source: Annual Overview tab (monthly totals) + Monthly Overview tab (category split for the selected month)
actuals.note: Jan-Jul 2026 predates employment, so those income figures are complete as recorded. Aug 2026 onward, add the $4,800 take-home to whatever the sheet logs.

incomeByCategory._note: Annual Overview → Monthly Income table. One row per category, values Jan..Aug 2026.

expenseByCategory._note: Monthly Overview tab, which computes ONE month at a time from its own Month/Year selector. It was set to July 2026 when read, so this split is July 2026 only. Other months have totals but no category split available from these two tabs.

scope.label: Joseph
scope.note: This file is Joseph's dataset. Melissa's lives in finance-melissa.json. The Combined tab is derived in the browser from the two — it is never stored.

balances._note: The three fields Joseph fills in on his tab. null = not yet supplied; the dashboard shows 'unknown', never 0. Editing on the page is session-only until exported here. All SGD. Changed 9 Aug 2026 (Joseph): balances are now per-person — the old household 'cash' field and Melissa's fields moved out of this file. No values were lost; every field was null.

liabilities._note: Confirmed by Joseph. School Loan amortises $1,000/mo to his mother from Sep 2026. Mortgage is not drawn until Q1 2028.

rows.name: School Loan
rows.note: Owed to Joseph's mother. Begins reducing $1,000/mo from Sep 2026.

rows.name: Mortgage
rows.note: $440,000 remaining, split with Melissa. Not drawn until Q1 2028, so $0 outstanding today. Monthly repayment not yet known. Excluded from the net-worth line because the property it buys has no recorded value — counting the debt without the asset would show a false collapse. It still appears in the liabilities chart once drawn, and as a dotted marker on the cash map.

goals._note: Amounts, deadlines and funding sources stated by Joseph, 9 Aug 2026. Household scale. Required monthly contribution is derived from the deadline, never stored.

rows.name: BTO
rows.note: Hard deadline March 2028. Prioritise CPF, then cash.

emergencyFund._note: Not a goal. A standing cash floor that must always be held, sized at 2 months of combined take-home.

recurring._note: Standing commitments that are neither a goal nor a liability.

items.name: Insurance
items.detail: $82/mo plus an annual premium of about $200

decisions.name: Enter the five balances
decisions.detail: Cash, both investment balances and both CPF balances. BTO's CPF-first split cannot be computed until the CPF figures exist.

decisions.name: Keep logging in Monthly Overview
decisions.detail: From Aug 2026 the sheet only needs to capture income beyond the $4,800 salary, plus all expenses.

footer: Finance Intern — Steven · Source: My Income & Expenses (Monthly Overview + Annual Overview, Jan 2026 onwards)
